note: Unedited captures of the web app running locally in offline mode with the template generator. The answers are what the system produced in that state; they are not evaluation results. source_commit is the development commit of the client; client_files_sha256 is a digest over backend/src/smartagri/research_api/static/ (sorted relative path, NUL, sha256 of each file, newline) and can be recomputed from this repository.
